name: Castorcito Advanced Pack
description: Sub-module of Castorcito that installs advanced ready-to-use components (a Swiper.js slider and a timeline) as configuration, bundling the Swiper library.
project_description: Castorcito Advanced Pack is a sub-module of Castorcito that ships advanced components as configuration (castorcito_component and castorcito_category config entities) with their Single Directory Components and a bundled Swiper.js library. It currently provides a Swiper-based slider (with item child component) and a timeline (with item child component); more advanced components are planned. Like the base pack, its components are meant to be cloned and adapted, and their markup can be overridden from a theme via the SDC replaces key.
